WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('9999999999999999.99' AS DECIMAL(21,2))
                      WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-9999999999999999.99' AS DECIMAL(21,2))
                      WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(21,2))
                      ELSE CAST(dec AS DECIMAL(21,2)) END AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, CAST(value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS result, TRY_CAST(value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS tried FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('1.01' AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                      WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-1.01' AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                      WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) ELSE dec END AS dividend,
               CASE id WHEN 2 THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                       WHEN 3 THEN CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                       ELSE CAST(2 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END AS divisor
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, CAST(ROUND(dividend/divisor,2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS result FROM operands
